subject.title: fix(skills): refuse owner-qualified ClawHub force install over a different owner

question: Should OpenClaw make owner-qualified `skills install --force` fail when the same local skill slug is already tracked under a different owner?
rationale: The patch protects installed state and aligns install with update/verify owner matching, but it changes the force-install contract for any workflow that intentionally used cross-owner same-slug replacement.

options.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
options.body: Merge this PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

options.title: Require explicit owner-change path
options.body: Ask for a deliberate override or migration path if cross-owner replacement should remain possible without silent clobbering.

options.title: Preserve current force behavior
options.body: Reject the guard and keep `--force` as unconditional same-slug replacement across owners, accepting the installed-state risk.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a ClawHub behavior policy decision and CONTRIBUTING.md lists this person as a ClawHub area owner.
